title: 1940s Clearing the tracks in Hartland
description: Clearing the tracks, 1940s. Since 1874, the train has been vital to the valley, providing passenger service, connecting the region, supporting timber and agricultural trade, spurring economic growth, and creating a new transcontinental market. Each day, two trains passed through Hartland—one northbound and one southbound. (Photo courtesy of Don Oliver)
